artworks.title: No One Who Puts His Hand on the Plow and Looks Back ia a Follower of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man plowing a field with oxen. The artwork shows a man guiding a plow pulled by two oxen, with onlookers nearby. In the background, there is a landscape with buildings and hills. The drawing includes text in German at the bottom. The style features intricate line work, strong contrast, and detailed texture.

artworks.title: The Parable of the Good Samaritan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring two figures in a detailed landscape. One figure, wearing traditional clothing, tends to another who is reclining by a tree. A horse stands nearby with various equipment. In the background, there are rolling hills and a distant cityscape. The drawing includes text at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Payment of Judas
artworks.description: The image depicts seven figures gathered around a table. One man is standing on the left, facing the table and gesturing with his hands. The other figures are seated or standing around the table. The table is decorated with scattered coins. The background is minimal, with a plain wall featuring a rectangular panel or recess.

artworks.title: The Kiss of Judas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. A group of robed figures is standing in the foreground, some engaging with each other. The scene is near a fence with wooden stakes, and rolling hills can be seen in the background. To the right, a group of armored soldiers with shields and spears are approaching. The artist differentiated between various elements like the folds of the robes and the textures of the armor. Underneath the drawing, there is text suggesting the scene's significance. The attention to detail in the clothing, particularly the drapery and gesture, adds character to the scene.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas, and Peter Denying Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The image is divided into two panels. In the left panel, a figure is standing before a seated ruler with two guards behind him. In the right panel, three figures are shown pointing towards an elaborately decorated facade with the date 1548 inscribed on it. A rooster sits on a shelf above. Near them, a solitary figure is seated with his hand to his face. Text beneath the drawing mentions a denial before the crowing of the rooster.

artworks.title: Christ Ascending the Cross with Sin, Death, and the Devil
artworks.medium: etching and letterpress on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man climbing a ladder with a cross, carrying multiple figures. The drawing shows a muscular figure ascending a ladder leaning against a large wooden cross, while carrying several small, seemingly lifeless figures slung over his back. The scene is set in a landscape with a river or body of water in the background, curving around a village or settlement. In the distance, rocky hills or mountains rise, creating a shallow horizon line. Below the image, there is German text with the name "Corinth" indicating a connection to religious scripture. The art style is intricate and expressive.

artworks.title: Christ Appears to the Apostles
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered together in an indoor setting. One person stands on the right side facing the group. This person has a beard, short hair, and is wearing robes. They are holding a staff topped with a flag that has a cross. The group consists of about twelve people with various expressions, most of whom are men with beards and short to medium-length hair, wearing robes. The scene includes a tiled floor, a ceiling with wooden beams, walls adorned with decorations, and a doorway on the left. Text in an older form of German is present below the scene.

artworks.title: Jesus Identifies Himself before the Arrest
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with multiple figures, an archway, and a tree. The central figure gestures with one hand while facing a group of individuals to the right. To the left, a group of armored figures appear to be falling or recoiling. The backdrop features an archway and a simple fence or wall, with a tree nearby. The sky above features swirling clouds. Below the image, there is a block of text in German script. The drawing is executed with precision, emphasizing line work typical of engravings or woodcuts from the Renaissance or Baroque periods.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo, and the Jews Deny Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures. Some are standing on a staircase, with one figure being pointed at. In the foreground, a group of figures, all in similar flowing robes, are gathered together, with one in front gesturing towards a central figure atop a set of steps. The central figure appears to be holding a staff and is flanked by another figure in robes, both positioned near an architectural structure. The scene is depicted in a line drawing style that emphasizes the drapery and form of the figures. The figures are detailed in expression and posture, capturing a moment of interaction with implied significance, highlighted by the architectural backdrop and the written text below the scene.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene depicting a crowd gathered around a central figure carrying a large cross. The scene includes armored soldiers, onlookers, and crosses on a hill in the background. The foreground shows dynamic interactions among figures, suggesting an emotional and movement-filled narrative moment. The artist uses line work to create depth and texture. Below the scene, there is an ornately written text.

artworks.title: The Nailing to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a depiction of a person nailed to a cross, with surrounding individuals carrying out actions related to the crucifixion. Some are using a hammer, possibly driving a nail, while others are observing. The setting is outdoors with a landscape showing distant hills or mountains. Below the image, there is text in a blackletter typeface. The style of the drawing is detailed and illustrative, reminiscent of engravings or prints from historical periods.

artworks.title: Christ is Given Vinegar to Drink
artworks.description: The image features a crucifixion scene with a central figure on a cross, surrounded by other figures in armor and robes. The background shows a village or town with buildings and landscapes. The drawing is detailed with fine line work and includes inscriptions beneath the scene in an old script or language.

artworks.title: Christ is Pierced with the Lance
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with a cityscape in the background. The scene depicts a figure on a cross with various individuals around, some interacting emotionally, while a more distant architectural landscape can be seen. The composition of the scene includes swirling clouds above, a focus on the central crucifixion figure, and a use of shading to emphasize depth and articulation of the human forms. The city in the background includes buildings with domed and steepled rooftops. Ornate clothing and detailed expressions contribute to the dramatic and emotive nature of the scene. The text below the drawing adds contextual significance to the artwork, which is characterized by bold line work and intricate detailing.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing on top of a rectangular structure, holding a staff with a flag in one hand and raising the other hand with two fingers extended. The figure has a beard, long hair, and draped clothing. Surrounding this central figure are additional figures in armored attire, three of them positioned below in reclined poses. The background consists of lined, shaded textures creating a solid backdrop, and beneath the structure are patterns resembling stone or tile.

artworks.title: Judas Returns the Thirty Pieces of Silver
artworks.description: This is a drawing with two panels. The left panel shows two figures in robes having a discussion in front of a building. The right panel shows a man holding a bag walking away from a hanging figure near a tree. The drawing is detailed with line work, resembling early German Renaissance art like Albrecht Dürer. The composition tells a story set in a historical context with intricate environmental and architectural elements. Below the panels, there is text in a Gothic font providing narrative context.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people kneeling in prayer with flames above their heads and a dove emanating light appearing above them. The room is rectangular with a tile floor, a plain wall in the background, and beams on the ceiling. At the top center of the drawing, there is a depiction of a dove surrounded by radiant light with beams extending outwards. The figures are arranged symmetrically, kneeling in rows on either side and looking up towards the bird. The style is characterized by detailed line work and hatching. Below the scene, there is an inscription in an old script.

artworks.title: The Punishment of Ananias and Sapphira
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures and text. It depicts a bearded figure on the left gesturing towards another figure lying on the ground, with two figures behind them carrying a third one. The landscape includes sparse foliage and low hills in the background. At the bottom, there is text in a decorative font. The drawing is rendered in a linear style with fine lines detailing the characters and setting.

artworks.title: The Preparation of the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures working on wooden beams. The figures are engaged in cutting and shaping large wooden beams that form a cross. Their attire is reminiscent of ancient or medieval style robes, and one of them appears to be hammering, while another is sawing. The scene is set outdoors with a landscape that includes hills or mountains visible in the background. The lower section of the drawing contains a block of text in old lettering.

artworks.title: The Cross of Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a vast landscape with a wooden cross in the foreground. In the background, there is a detailed townscape with various architectural elements like spires and pitched roofs. Rolling hills and a lone tree complete the scene. The artwork is created using intricate linework and delicate brushstrokes, primarily in brown tones on paper.

artworks.title: The Harrowing of Hell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures coming out of an arched doorway in a rocky landscape. To the left, a creature is in the doorway. The main figure in the foreground is holding a flag. There are other figures exiting the doorway. Below the scene, there is text in a Gothic script.

artworks.title: The Opening of the Seventh Seal
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing celestial and terrestrial elements within a circular motif. The image includes angelic figures, celestial bodies, and architectural elements arranged in a circular framework. Two angelic beings with wings are depicted at the top of the image, surrounded by clouds with cherub faces. The circular motif features inscriptions in Latin, "SEVENVI.," and trumpets emerging from clouds around the perimeter. Within the circle, a landscape with burning buildings and flames extends towards the sky. The sun and moon are positioned on opposite sides. Gothic script provides a textual narrative below the scene.

artworks.title: Job Learns of His Misfortunes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in dialogue and interaction. The central focus is on a group of individuals engaged in a scene. A woman stands prominently in the middle, gesturing. Her attention is directed towards a kneeling man on the right. To the left, two figures are engaging with another figure. The background features an expanse of open skies and distant architectural structures. The drawing is detailed with fine, intricate lines, showcasing a classical style typical of historical illustrative prints. The artist has included text underneath. The work likely intends to depict a historical or allegorical scene.

artworks.title: Map of Eastern Europe with portraits of Sigismund von Herberstein, Emperor Charles V, Emperor Maximilian I, Ferdinand of Hungary, Ludwig II of Hungary, Sigismund I of Poland, Sigismund II of Poland, Christian II of Denmark, Suleiman the Magnificent and Vasili III, Grand Prince of Moscow, and vignettes showing four journeys made by Herberstein
artworks.description: The image features portrait medallions of historical figures in circular frames, depicted from the shoulders up. The men have various hairstyles and wear period clothing with robes or high-collared garments. Some wear hats. The central part of the image includes a detailed map with labeled rivers and locations. On the left, a seated figure in elaborate clothing and a turban is depicted. On the right, another seated figure wears a fur-trimmed cape and hat. The bottom portion shows scenes of a sledge, a horse and rider, a horse-drawn carriage, and a sailing ship on water. The background is off-white with inscriptions and decorations separating the sections, resembling a historical document.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Village Church
artworks.description: The image depicts a village scene in fine line art. A church is seen on the right, with a steeple reaching upwards. Rolling hills and distant structures like a castle are visible in the background. The landscape includes detailed trees with branches and foliage sketched in swift strokes. The color scheme is monochromatic, in shades of black and white. A winding path leads from the church through the village. The foreground shows a wooden cart and part of a building. The composition balances natural elements and man-made structures.
